title: Every outgoing email follows the member kit: stock hero, pastel pill, ink links, no crossover violet

source.ref: owner 2026-10-19 in the project chat: redesign the email theme, remove the violet, add a stock hero with a blue and purple orb and five play photos, evolve the layout; PROG-EMAIL1

detail: FILED AND BUILT 2026-10-19. THE CONSEQUENCE: EMAIL-023 to 027 re-coloured the old DAWN layout from the Commons token file, so every email went out in system fonts, a flat layout and a violet (#5B3FD0) button and link colour that the member kit never uses; the owner rejected it three times. THE FIX: the shells (lib/email.ts emailShell, lib/email-studio/shell.ts, lib/email-react/shell.tsx) and the block renderer follow the member kit (ADR-1800, docs/EMAIL-LAYOUT.md): linen canvas under the wash, a raised radius-24 card under a stock hero of five adult-play photos with a blue orb bottom left and a purple orb top right (random per dispatch; a Space's own header replaces it), Unbounded titles, a pastel kicker pill, a facts panel, round-go list rows, the pastel --pa pill with ink text, ink links, a night room under prefers-color-scheme. Every module that hand-built a violet button now calls emailButton; the editor canvas shows the hero. Pins on the old look were recaptured on the owner's tap: the LIVE-877 fixture and its SHA, the wordmark test, the receipt goldens and three receipt shell tests. The probe reads the sources for any use of the violet primary in email, the hero set and its files, and the shared pieces; the catalog test fails any rendered sample containing #5B3FD0.

verify.note: PASS 2026-10-19: no email module reads palette.primary or onPrimary, no email palette key is the violet, five hero files exist under 120 KB each and are listed in email-type.ts, the shells and the editor canvas mount the hero, and the four shared pieces are exported and used.
